title: Regression testing: does what already worked still work?

videos.script: Release 1.1 passed its sanity check. Both fixes work. {{passed}} So is it ready? Not yet. A fix changes code, and that code was doing other jobs before the fix arrived. {{shared}} Regression testing asks one question of a new build. Does everything that worked before still work? {{question}} You cannot rerun every test on every release. So you choose, by risk and by what the release changed. {{choose}} In this lesson you choose twenty checks for 1.1, from the risks of lesson 1, and run them. {{run}} Four of them fail, and they fail in a pattern. {{pattern}} Then you start the old version beside the new one, send both the same request, and watch them disagree. {{compare}} That is a regression, and by the end you will know how to find one, prove it, and keep the suite that found it worth running. {{alive}}
